conditional-normalizing-flow.integration: threshold at half-integer directly in dequantized distribution; no rounding

protocol.selection: Fixed model configurations. Fit on refit window only; no test-selected hyperparameters/epochs. Per-target shrinkage weights selected on calibration day only. All raw and calibrated outcomes reported; no automatic winner or promotion.
protocol.forestSemantics: Multioutput classification trained once per configuration; all heads share tree partitions. Calibration per head may break cross-market coherence; experimental only.
protocol.btSemantics: Winner only; regularized player strength by competition, fitted to all BO5 source-reported past results available before cutoff, no future players; unseen player strength=0.
limitations: Entire historical archive and source outcomes already inspected by earlier research; temporal separation is not new independent validation.
No historical executable as-of odds in this feature archive; odds-enhanced benchmark/ROI cannot be computed.
Source-reported results and closing times, not independently certified official records.
Per-head calibration/direct models do not ensure one coherent joint distribution across every market.
No promotion or modification of original prospective protocols.
New model choices made after earlier historical benchmarks were inspected; this is exploratory, not independent validation.

Flow models final total and point difference continuously; it does not encode legal match paths or score parity, and covers point markets only. Monte Carlo error and cross-market coherence limitations apply.
Frozen candidate settings are a bounded first comparison, not exhaustive tuning.
